data.name: 24K Cleopatra Regime facial Treatment
data.description:
Short Description 
None

What It Does & Benefits
Removes impurities: The treatment cleanses and exfoliates the skin, removing dead skin cells, dirt, and excess oils.
Stimulates collagen production: 24K gold encourages collagen synthesis, improving skin elasticity and reducing fine lines and wrinkles.
Improves skin texture: Provides smoother, softer, and more even skin tone.
Hydrates and nourishes: Deeply hydrates the skin, leaving it plump, moisturized, and rejuvenated.
Brightens and evens complexion: The treatment works to enhance skin radiance and promote a more even skin tone.
Anti-inflammatory effects: Gold particles in the treatment have anti-inflammatory properties, soothing irritated skin.

Instructions
Cleanse: Begin with a deep cleanse to remove makeup, dirt, and impurities from the skin.
Exfoliate: Apply an exfoliating scrub or mask to slough off dead skin cells and prepare the skin for better absorption of the active ingredients.
Apply 24K Gold Serum: Gently massage a serum infused with 24K gold into the skin to stimulate collagen production and increase skin elasticity.
Facial Massage: Use upward strokes to massage the product into the skin, promoting relaxation, circulation, and better product absorption.
Hydrating Mask: Apply a hydrating mask to nourish and lock in moisture. Leave on for 10-15 minutes.
Finishing Serum and Moisturizer: Follow up with a finishing serum and moisturizer to seal in hydration and provide long-lasting results.
Sunscreen (if daytime): Apply sunscreen to protect the skin from UV damage and maintain the benefits of the treatment.

Active Ingredients
24K Gold: Enhances collagen production, reduces signs of aging, and promotes a glowing complexion.
Hyaluronic Acid: Provides deep hydration, plumping the skin and smoothing fine lines.
Vitamin C: Brightens the skin and reduces dark spots while offering antioxidant protection.
Peptides: Help in restoring skin elasticity and reducing wrinkles.
Aloe Vera: Soothes and calms the skin, reducing redness and inflammation.
Retinol: Stimulates skin renewal, reducing fine lines and improving skin texture.

Skin Type
Suitable for all skin types, especially mature, dry, and sensitive skin. Ideal for individuals seeking anti-aging benefits, hydration, and a radiant complexion.

data.name: 30 min Cleanse, Serum, Hydrate & LED
data.description:
Short Description
The 30-Minute Cleanse Facial Treatment is a quick, effective skincare procedure designed to deeply cleanse the skin, removing impurities and excess oils while refreshing and rejuvenating the complexion. Ideal for busy schedules, this treatment focuses on cleansing, exfoliating, and hydrating the skin in a short amount of time to leave the skin feeling clean, smooth, and refreshed.

What It Does & Benefits
Removes impurities: Effectively cleanses the skin by removing dirt, oil, and makeup, leaving it fresh and balanced.
Unclogs pores: Exfoliates the skin gently, clearing blocked pores and preventing breakouts.
Hydrates and nourishes: Restores moisture to the skin, keeping it soft and hydrated.
Improves skin texture: Gently smooths and refines the skin's surface for a brighter and more even complexion.
Refreshes and energizes: Provides an instant refreshing boost, leaving the skin feeling invigorated.

Instructions
Cleanse: Start by applying a gentle cleanser to the face to remove surface dirt and makeup. Use lukewarm water and a soft cloth or your hands.
Exfoliate: Apply an exfoliating scrub or enzyme treatment to remove dead skin cells and clear pores. Massage gently in circular motions for 1-2 minutes.
Mask (optional): If desired, apply a hydrating or purifying mask and leave on for 5-10 minutes, depending on the type of mask.
Tone: Apply a toner to balance the skin’s pH levels and prepare it for hydration.
Moisturize: Follow with a hydrating moisturizer to lock in moisture and ensure soft, smooth skin.
Sunscreen (if daytime): Apply sunscreen to protect the skin from UV damage after the treatment.

Active Ingredients
Hyaluronic Acid: Hydrates and plumps the skin, maintaining moisture balance.
Salicylic Acid: Gently exfoliates and clears pores, ideal for oily or acne-prone skin.
Aloe Vera: Soothes and calms the skin, reducing irritation and redness.
Vitamin C: Brightens the skin and provides antioxidant protection.
Glycerin: Helps retain moisture, ensuring a smooth and hydrated feel.
Green Tea Extract: Calms the skin and provides anti-inflammatory benefits.

Skin Type
Suitable for all skin types, especially oily, combination, and sensitive skin. This treatment is gentle enough for sensitive skin but effective at clearing impurities and refreshing the complexion.

data.name: Cold Plasma
data.description:
Short Description
Cold Plasma is a high-tech skincare treatment that uses low-temperature, ionized gas (plasma) to improve skin health. This treatment is designed to stimulate skin cells, promote healing, and enhance the absorption of other active ingredients in skincare products. The technology can be used for a variety of skin concerns, including signs of aging, inflammation, and uneven texture.

What It Does & Benefits
Improves Skin Texture: Helps smooth the skin by promoting collagen production and increasing cell turnover.
Reduces Fine Lines & Wrinkles: Stimulates the skin’s natural repair process, which can reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles.
Balances Skin Tone: Helps even out skin tone and texture by targeting pigmentation and boosting the skin’s regeneration process.
Hydrates & Firms Skin: Boosts skin hydration and can improve firmness and elasticity by enhancing the absorption of moisture.
Soothes & Calms the Skin: The cold plasma technology has anti-inflammatory properties, making it beneficial for those with sensitive or irritated skin.

Instructions
Cleanse the Skin: Start with a clean face by removing makeup, dirt, and oils.
Apply Serum (Optional): If using with a serum, apply it to your face before the Cold Plasma device for enhanced absorption.
Cold Plasma Application: Using a Cold Plasma device or facial treatment, apply the cold plasma to the skin. This process is painless, and you will typically feel a cool sensation.
Post-Treatment Care: After the treatment, apply a gentle moisturizer and sunscreen. If using at home, follow the device instructions for the recommended frequency and usage.

Active Ingredients
Ionized Gas (Plasma): The primary component in Cold Plasma treatment, which is electrically charged and helps to stimulate the skin at a cellular level.
Hyaluronic Acid: Often paired with Cold Plasma, this ingredient helps to deeply hydrate the skin and plump the complexion.
Peptides: Assist in stimulating collagen production, improving skin strength and elasticity.
Vitamin C & E: Provide antioxidant protection and help to brighten the skin.

Skin Type
Cold Plasma is suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin, due to its gentle yet effective nature. It is particularly beneficial for individuals with: Aging skin (fine lines, wrinkles), Dull, uneven skin tone Dry or dehydrated skin, Sensitive or irritated skin
